title: codeAudit
responsibility: Checks intact verification and matching runtime observations for affected and explicitly requested units at one committed revision.

inputs.name: codeAudit.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: codeAudit.commit
inputs.description: Exact Git source commit whose verification and measurements must agree.

inputs.name: codeAudit.requested
inputs.description: Additional registered unit IDs that must exist and satisfy the same evidence rules.

outputs.name: codeAudit
outputs.description: Checks for intact exact-commit verification, declared unit scope and matching representative runtime evidence.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Missing, failed, tampered or stale verification rejects before the task can claim completion.
